facilities.name: Danone - Mount Crawford VA
facilities.address: 6364 South Valley Pike, Mount Crawford, VA 22841
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page; address confirmed via Bandana/EPA FRS and HR Chamber listings. Largest Danone facility - 640,000 sq ft, 97 acres, 700+ employees. Produces Silk, International Delight, SToK, So Delicious, Horizon, Dunkin'.

facilities.name: Danone - Minster OH
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. 371,000 sq ft, ~440 employees, ~2.2M lbs/day. Produces Activia, Oikos, Dannon Fruit on the Bottom, Danimals, Light + Fit, Triple Zero. Aug 2025 expansion (+48,000 sq ft).

facilities.name: Danone - Jacksonville FL (plant)
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page; PRNewswire June 2025 expansion release. 115,025 sq ft, on site since 1948. Produces International Delight, SToK Cold Brew. $65M new line opened June 17, 2025.

facilities.name: Danone - Jacksonville FL (distribution center)
facilities.source: Danone PRNewswire/Jax Daily Record June 2025: new Jacksonville-area regional DC announced alongside the $65M plant expansion (~200 combined jobs). Exact street address not yet public as of May 2026 - facility under construction/ramp-up.

facilities.name: Danone - City of Industry CA
facilities.address: 18275 Arenth Avenue, City of Industry, CA 91748
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page; address from Wikipedia/careers facility detail. 284,000 sq ft, 336 employees, founded 1986. Produces Silk Beverage, SToK Coffee, International Delight Creamer.

facilities.name: Danone - Dallas TX
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. 609,000 sq ft combined (357,000 sq ft main + 252,000 sq ft toppers), ~575 employees. Produces Silk, International Delight, SToK, So Delicious, toppers. Receiving relocated Bridgeton NJ production.

facilities.name: Danone - DuBois PA
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. 189,158 sq ft, ~145 employees, founded 2014. Only Danone NA plant-based yogurt producer - Silk dairy-free yogurt, So Delicious, Harmless Harvest Dairy-Free.

facilities.name: Danone - Springfield OR
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. ~150 employees. Only North American plant-based frozen-dessert plant - So Delicious Dairy Free ice cream.

facilities.name: Danone - Fort Worth TX
facilities.address: 1300 West Peter Smith Street, Fort Worth, TX 76104
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page; Fort Worth Report Jan 2026. ~11-acre site, ~210 employees, founded 1925, in Near Southside district adjacent to I-30. Produces Danimals, Activia, YoCrunch. $4M expansion underway 2026.

facilities.name: Danone - Bridgeton NJ
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. 185,000 sq ft, founded 2001, ~120 employees. Produces Silk dairy-free, So Delicious Oatmilk, creamers. NOTE: closure announced - shutting Aug 2, 2026, with 114 layoffs; production moving to Mount Crawford, Dallas, Jacksonville. Still operating as of audit date (May 2026).

facilities.name: Danone - Chatsworth CA
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. Solar-powered (2,000+ panels). Produces Follow Your Heart, Boursin, Silk. Legacy Follow Your Heart facility.

facilities.name: Danone - Portland OR
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. 187,308 sq ft, ~60 employees. Legacy YoCream facility - frozen yogurt/ice cream for club channel (Costco, Sam's Club).

facilities.name: Danone - West Jordan UT
facilities.address: 6165 West Dannon Way, West Jordan, UT 84081
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page; ChamberWest listing. 51.17-acre site, 13 production lines, ~310 employees, founded 1997. Produces Activia, Danimals, Oikos, Light + Fit, Danonino.

facilities.name: Danone - Scottsdale AZ
facilities.source: Danone careers 'Our Locations' page. Small site - 10,000 sq ft, ~23 employees; supports 60,000+ foodservice/dispensing customer locations. Included as 13th manufacturing-list site, but it is an equipment/dispensing operation, not a high-volume freight yard - low audit priority.
